answers.evidence:
Verified three ways — unit tests, HTTP integration tests, and a live server + curl:

```
$ go test -race ./...   → ok  go-mcp-jsonrpc-param-shape/mcp, cmd/server  (33 tests pass)
```

Table tests covered: standard shape, legacy shape, both-present (standard wins), name-without-args, tool-without-input, null arguments, nested/array args, `{}` → error, `null` → error, stray-field → error, plus 5 "resolve identically" cases (scalar, no args, nested, null, empty-object).

Live curl against the built server:

| Request | Result |
|---|---|
| `params:{"name":"greet","arguments":{"name":"World"}}` | **200** `"greeting":"Hello, World!"` |
| `params:{"tool":"greet","input":{"name":"Legacy"}}` | **200** `"greeting":"Hello, Legacy!"` |
| both shapes present | **200** — standard wins (`"Hello, Std!"`) |
| `params:{}` | **400** `{"code":-32602,"message":"tool name is required"}` |
| params missing / `null` | **400** `"tool name is required"` |

Edge cases verified: `name` present without `arguments`, `tool` present without `input`, `"arguments":null`, nested/array arguments, `null` and missing params, unknown method (`-32601`). `gofmt`, `go vet`, and `-race` are all clean. Files: `mcp/params.go`, `mcp/handler.go`, `mcp/params_test.go`, `mcp/handler_test.go`, `cmd/server/main.go`, `cmd/server/main_test.go` under `/home/kara/go-mcp-jsonrpc-param-shape`.
